Short answers from security/infra: 
- SOC2: We have a SOC2 Type II report for 2024 — attaching the redacted PDF. That should satisfy most procurement questionnaires. If they need an NDA first, we can wrap the report behind an NDA; let me know.
- RFI answers: I completed a short-form security FAQ addressing data retention, encryption in transit & at rest, key management (we support customer-managed KMS for Private), and logging/audit retention. See attached text file.

2) Expected data residency requirements? (US-only, multi-region)
